claims.text: The local catalog and selected PokemonWiki snapshot model Team Rocket Gift Pack as released on December 19, 1997.
The selected PokemonWiki snapshot records 120 cards, two 60-card decks, 30 damage counters, 8 poison markers, a special playmat, and a guidebook for the Team Rocket Gift Pack product.

The local catalog deliberately models 130 unresolved candidate rows as 2 x 65 Rocket Gang source rows because the fixed per-deck lists are not source-pinned here; those 130 rows are not a claim of 130 physical cards.

The local release map marks Team Rocket Gift Pack as a two-player gift product and separately records Rocket Gang as the 65-card booster release, so the product context must stay distinct from the booster checklist.
The local symbol-status matrix keeps Team Rocket Gift Pack symbol status unresolved and warns not to infer it from Rocket Gang booster status.
The generated queue and local candidate rows surface Dark Charizard, Dark Blastoise, and Dark Gyarados in both modeled component lanes as high-attention candidate rows, not fixed deck-list proof.

Team Rocket Gift Pack matters because it is a packaged play object rather than only a checklist: two fixed decks, counters, markers, a playmat, and a guidebook show Pokemon being assembled as a tabletop apparatus for two people.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, sealed product note, or agent search says Team Rocket Gift Pack, Rocket Gang Gift Pack, two Rocket decks, fixed Rocket deck, or Gift Pack Dark Charizard.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Team Rocket Gift Pack is a product context with two documented 60-card decks, but this catalog has unresolved fixed deck lists and only models candidate rows.
steps: Preserve release_family_id jp_tcg_team_rocket_gift_pack_19971219 for the product context.
Do not claim that any modeled candidate row is a fixed deck inclusion unless a later source-pinned deck list proves it.
Do not treat the 130 catalog rows as 130 physical product cards; the product count is documented as 120 cards across two 60-card decks.
Do not infer symbol status from Rocket Gang booster status; this release remains unverified in the local symbol-status matrix.
Keep Team Rocket Gift Pack distinct from Rocket Gang booster rows and from English Team Rocket rows.
For sealed or complete-product claims, require product photographs and source-pinned contents evidence before advancing beyond catalog context.

narrative.human_title: The Rocket apparatus in a box
narrative.why_it_matters: Team Rocket Gift Pack is where Rocket Gang stops being only a booster world and becomes a table for two. The counters, poison markers, playmat, guidebook, and two fixed decks matter because they show Pokemon being packaged as a ritual of play, not just as cards to pull. The catalog has to be unusually honest here: the product is real, the 120-card shape is sourced, but the exact fixed deck lists are not pinned in this dataset yet.
